title: Copper Zaishen Coin
wikitext: __NOTOC__{{item infobox | image = [[Image:Copper Zaishen Coin.png|Copper Zaishen Coin]] | type = [[Reward trophy]] | value = ''Can't be sold'' | rarity = [[Zaishen Coin#Notes|Special]] | collector = | render = }} [[Copper Zaishen Coin]]s are part of the reward of [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]]s and can be used for different goals, such as unlocking pet tiers in the [[Zaishen Menagerie]]. == Acquisition == * Reward from [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]]s. * Random drop from [[Zaishen Strongbox]]es. * [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from [[Silver Zaishen Coin]]s. == Collector == *[[The Battle Isles]] **[[Embark Beach]] or [[Great Temple of Balthazar]] ***[[Tesla]] == Notes == * 1 [[Gold Zaishen Coin]] costs 500{{zcopper}} and {{cost|150}}. * Unlike [[Silver Zaishen Coin|Silver]] and Gold Zaishen Coins, Copper Zaishen Coins cannot be [[salvage]]d. * See [[Zaishen Coin]] for a list of all items offered with prices converted for all Zaishen Coins. == Trivia == * This item was introduced in the [[Game updates/20090423|April 23, 2009 update]]; they could not be [[trade]]d until the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110602|June 2, 2011 update]]. * This item uses a unique text font color. {{Reward trophies nav}} [[Category:Zaishen trophies]]
